findings.one_line: The claimed operation ceiling omits the required chart co-containment checks: with O(2^{c_max}) base cells and r_id large enough that all pairs can be close, the literal all-pairs test costs O(4^{c_max}), while B(Xi) includes only G_# 2^{c_max} chart leaves; add this cost (or give a valid non-pairwise verification).
